body:
Well, a friend of mine, we'll call him Josh, had a sweet deal going on.  If he bought some crank, he'd get some free.
I had $50, and another friend (C) had $50.  He went to get a gram for us.  She gave him another gram for himself, because the last time he bought some she didn't give him any extra.
We got back and split it up.  We gave C a half gram, and put the rest in the same bag, because we'd be doing it together anyway.
We smoked off a large tin-foil strip, bent in a V shape so the smoke travels along it.  Called a tinny around here.  Four of us matched about a quarter gram, so we smoked a gram in about ten minutes.
At this point, I felt extremely good.  I felt perfect.  I had an overwhelming desire to smoke cigarettes, so I did.  I think I smoked a pack in about an hour or two.  I was perfectly content with everything in the world.
We went somewhere, and smoked alot more.  From here on, we just smoked to keep up, to have fun.  At the end of the night, we went to Josh's house to get cigarettes, and then to another persons house to burn a tinny with her.  It felt like we were gone for fifteen minutes, and a half hour would have been pushing it.  We came back, and realized we were gone for two hours.  Time flew, and at the same time it crawled.
One time when I went home to take a shower, change clothes, etc.  I was gone for about three hours, but it felt like perhaps an hour at most.  My clothes were washed and dried, and I was out of the shower in what felt like ten minutes.  I couldn't believe it.  Time is very, very distorted on it.
Another thing that was odd was my desire to smoke cigarettes.  It wasn't like a normal nicotene withdrawl.  In fact, it eased my addiction to cigarettes.  I could go for hours without a cigarette, if I was occupied.  But when I was doing nothing, I had to smoke them.  Out of habit, for something to do, I don't know.  I just wanted to smoke them, and my lungs took the blow.  After I came down and slept, I got a horrible cough.
Now I'll write about the sleep deprevation.  No effects were noticed from it untill the third day.
We probably smoked about six or seven grams in about three days (no sleep).  By the beginning of the fourth day (about midnight) I was starting to have minor audial/visual hallucinations.  This was my main desire beforehand, to experience them.  Slowing down our smoking very, very much, they began to become extreme.  Things wold pulsate, or throb.  At one point, I was sitting in a chair, watching a movie.  I though I was sitting in a chair at home, watching CNN.  It's truly bizzare delerium.  Almost like datura, but much weaker.  I'd go on small rants, and change the subject at least two or three times during it, not noticing.  By the end of the rant, I'd forget what I was talking about.  There were two dogs that accompanied us the three days (except the time they slept).  I couldn't remember either of their names at times.  I kept on calling one 'cujo', and the other 'georgia'.  Their names are Cooper and Meagan.
By the fourth morning, we were all out.  We had enough money for a gram, but our dealer crashed before us.  Left in the cold, I decided to come down and sleep.  I came home, ate a few pickles (the first thing I had eaten in four days), and crashed -hard-.  I woke up with a horrible cough from all the smoking, and very tired.
Overall, it was fun.  I'll do it again some time, but not anytime soon.  It's fun to loose yourself and go all out on the stuff, but it's not for the weak-willed, as the cravings become rather intense.  The first thing on my mind when I woke up was another tinny, and the desire was very strong.  The toll on the body and brain it has is just too much for me.
